text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Causal mapping of human brain function

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Mapping

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: human brain function is a long-standing goal of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: neuroscience that promises to inform the development

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: of new treatments for brain disorders. Early maps of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: human brain function were based on locations of brain

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: damage or brain stimulation that caused a functional

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: change. Over time, this approach was largely replaced

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: by technologies such as functional neuroimaging, which

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: identify brain regions in which activity is correlated with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: behaviours or symptoms. Despite their advantages,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: these technologies reveal correlations, not causation.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: This creates challenges for interpreting the data

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: generated from these tools and using them to develop

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: treatments for brain disorders. A return to causal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: mapping of human brain function based on brain lesions

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and brain stimulation is underway. New approaches can

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: combine these causal sources of information with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: modern neuroimaging and electrophysiology techniques

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: to gain new insights into the functions of specific brain

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: areas. In this Review, we provide a definition of causality

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: for translational research, propose a continuum along

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: which to assess the relative strength of causal

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: information from human brain mapping studies and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: discuss recent advances in causal brain mapping and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: their relevance for developing treatments.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b
font-style: italic; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Paper (title + abstract)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Changes in BOLD variability are linked to the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: development of variable response inhibition

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Research on the development of response inhibition in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: humans has focused almost exclusively on average

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: stopping performance. The development of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: intra-individual variability in stopping performance and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: its underlying neural circuitry has remained largely

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: unstudied, even though understanding variability is of

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: core importance for understanding development. In a

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: total sample of 45 participants (19 children aged 10–12

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: years and 26 adults aged 18–26 years) of either sex we

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: aimed to identify age-related changes in intra-individual

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: response inhibition performance and its underlying brain

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: signal variability. While there was no difference in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: average stopping performance between children and

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: adults, stop signal latencies for the children were more

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: variable. Further, brain signal variability during

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: successful stopping was significantly higher in adults

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: compared to children, especially in bilateral thalamus,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: but also across regions of the inhibition network. Finally,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: brain signal variability was significantly associated with

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: stopping performance behavioral variability in adults.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: Together these results indicate that variability in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: stopping performance decreases, whereas neural

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: variability in the inhibition network increases, from

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: childhood to adulthood. Future work will need to assess

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: whether developmental changes in neural variability

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: drive those in behavioral variability. In sum, both, neural

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: and behavioral variability indices might be a more

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: sensitive measure of developmental differences in

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: response inhibition compared to the standard

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: average-based measurements.
